usage: Prepared demo assets. Application playback reads local files and never calls an image API.

prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Prepare one polished product concept image for an offline software demonstration. Subject: navy blue urban commuter backpack made from subtly textured recycled polyester; rounded rectangular body, a zipped front pocket, padded shoulder straps, top carry handle, small plain rectangular embroidered patch on upper front. Approximate proportions 30cm wide 45cm high 15cm deep. Composition: one product only, centered three-quarter front view, entire bag visible with comfortable margin, square canvas. Style: high-end realistic industrial-design visualization, tactile textile and seam detail, convincing zippers, soft studio daylight and soft contact shadow, warm light grey seamless background. Consistent quiet catalog aesthetic. No people, no scenery, no brand names, no text, no watermark, no measurement annotations, no collage. This is a visual concept, not an engineering drawing.
